# `tatbot` command reference

<!-- GENERATED by `scripts/tatbot schema --md > docs/cli.md`. Do not edit; `scripts/check cli` fails when stale. -->

Offline CLI workflows for public development and replay. Maintainers can inspect the complete machine-readable schema with `tatbot schema --json`.

```
tatbot [global flags] <noun> [verb] [args] [-- passthrough args]
```

Global flags may appear anywhere before the first `--`, as `--flag value` or `--flag=value`, unless a declared command option owns that spelling: `--json`, `--dry-run`, `--explain`, `-q`, `-v`. Stating one twice with different values is a usage error.

`--json` execution is supported only by commands declaring structured output in `schema --json`; all commands support JSON plans and explanations. Backend flags on structured commands require `--`; tokens after it are preserved.

CLI-owned exit codes are below. Executed backends and SSH retain their own exit codes and error output; backend failures are not remapped to 1.

## Exit codes

| code | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | underlying tool failed |
| 2 | usage error |
| 3 | safety gate refused |
| 4 | wrong node for this verb |
| 5 | hardware unreachable |
| 6 | busy |

## Safety tiers

| tier | meaning | gates |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `offline` | files only | — |

## Bash completion

Generate and source completion explicitly (Bash 4+):

```sh
tatbot completion bash > /tmp/tatbot-completion.bash
source /tmp/tatbot-completion.bash
```

Generation prints shell code; it does not install anything or edit shell startup files. Completion is generated from the canonical commands, options and choices.


## Examples

```
tatbot completion bash
tatbot body bootstrap --spec config/body-models/mhr-soma-v1.json --cache-dir '<path>' --source-dir '<path>'
tatbot body audit --spec config/body-models/mhr-soma-v1.json --cache-dir '<path>'
tatbot teleop poses flight.wxtl --out '<path>' --urdf urdf/tatbot.urdf --workspace config/workspace.yaml
tatbot teleop analyze '<path>'
tatbot rollout bench plausibility -- --help
tatbot rollout contract '<path>'
tatbot calib register-fit --python '<path>' --arm pink --capture '<path>' --bundle '<path>' --setup-id table-setup --out '<path>'
tatbot vision depth compare --capture capture-1.npz --settings filters.json
tatbot vision stencil generate --preset silicone --seed 0 --output '<path>'
tatbot vision stencil reference --settings stencil/settings.json
tatbot vision tags print -- --help
tatbot vision handeye d405 --self-test
tatbot drawingbot generate '<path>' --out '<path>' --app '<path>'
tatbot drawingbot export '<path>' --out '<path>' --app '<path>'
tatbot drawingbot container build --out '<path>'
tatbot inkmap dev
tatbot inkmap resolve --prompt 'left upper inner forearm'
tatbot profile show
tatbot profile list
tatbot profile check
tatbot art swatch --inks golden_yellow,bright_red,light_green,light_purple,true_black --out '<path>'
tatbot art render '<path>' --substrate skin-3 --out '<path>'
tatbot art profile '<path>' --out '<path>'
tatbot art separate flash.png --inks golden_yellow,bright_red,light_green,blue_sky,true_black --width-mm 60 --out '<path>' --app '<path>'
tatbot art tiles --plan '<path>' --corpus '<path>' --stencil '<path>' --out '<path>' --app '<path>'
tatbot art stock-renders --app '<path>' --out '<path>'
tatbot art tone --app '<path>' --out '<path>'
tatbot art shade '<path>' --width-mm 30 --technique pendulum --tool '<tool-id>' --out '<path>'
tatbot art wall --round 1 --plan '<path>' --corpus '<path>' --assets '<path>' --out '<path>'
tatbot art propose --designs '<path>' --votes '<path>' --round 2 --out '<path>'
tatbot art map --designs '<path>' --corpus '<path>' --out '<path>'
tatbot art promote --designs '<path>' --votes '<path>' --corpus '<path>' --out '<path>'
tatbot art bundle --votes '<path>' --corpus '<path>' --out '<path>'
tatbot lab new --id card-3rl --question 'What does the 3RL lay at each depth?' --stencil '<path>' --cartridges '<tool-id>' --inks true_black,bright_red --palette true_black=inkcap_large_2,bright_red=inkcap_medium_1,water=inkcap_large_1 --bound trim_mm=-2.5:-1.0 --bound speed_mm_s=2.5:6
tatbot lab propose card-3rl --card '<tool-id>'
tatbot lab map card-3rl
tatbot lab plan card-3rl --stencil '<path>' --sheet bef888-a
tatbot lab status card-3rl
tatbot lab capture card-3rl --plan p0001 --run run-01 --side before
tatbot lab run card-3rl --plan p0001 --run run-01 --stencil '<path>' --sheet-at=400,-100
tatbot lab read card-3rl --plan p0001 --run run-01 --stencil '<path>'
```
